visa-preparation.entry_summary: Entry via Italy (Schengen Area rules apply).
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: No visa: Vatican City is reached through Rome, Italy, so the Schengen 90 days in 180 rule applies in practice.
steps: Areas beyond St Peter's and the Museums need permission.
At the first Schengen border, give fingerprints and a photo for the Entry/Exit System (EES); it's free.
Stays over 90 days need a national visa or a bilateral waiver arranged before travel.

public_holidays: Vatican City keeps the Catholic liturgical calendar: Epiphany 6 January, Easter and the days around it, Ascension, Pentecost, Sts Peter and Paul 29 June, Assumption 15 August, All Saints 1 November, Immaculate Conception 8 December, Christmas.
moving_calendars: 2027: Ash Wednesday 10 February; Holy Thursday 25 March; Good Friday 26 March; Easter 28 March (Easter Monday 29 March is on the service-public.gouv.fr table); Ascension 6 May; Pentecost 16 May; Corpus Christi 27 May.
closures: The Vatican Museums close on most Sundays and on some church holidays; check the Museums' own calendar before planning a visit.
culture-cycles.note: Dates are from the standard Roman Catholic calendar; Vatican pages were not reread today.
